learn.Text: I want to learn more about Omni-Tek...

what.Text: What is it you want done?

Text: {delay 1}Stand up straight and look me in the eye. You are addressing a superior officer.
Omni-Tek is recruiting. You, a new citizen on this planet, must embrace the Omni-Tek mantle and guard it with your life, as there are those who wish to see it destroyed.

history1.Text: Ah, yes, the grand history of the corporation - A long and proud one, to be sure. Omni-Tek is one of the few and only 'hyper corporations' in the galaxy, staffed by over one billion employees. Our company focuses in nearly every potential area of research, production, manufacturing and engineering, from finding resource-rich new worlds to colonize to turning those resources into the snack bars and action figures of tomorrow!  Founded on Earth in 12274, Omni-Tek is one of the oldest, most respected companies in the known universe, recognized as a leader in the free market and interstellar financial politics. Without a doubt, though, the crown jewel of Omni-Tek's aquisitions and holdings would be the very planet you now stand on - Rubi-Ka.

Text: {delay 1}With Rubi-Ka, Omni-Tek discovered a mineral that I'm certain needs no explaination to you - Notum. The basic building block of all nanotechnology. Without Notum none of our routine nanobot functions would work at all - Something that would be quite dire for the galaxy on the whole by this point, I assure you. And though there are... those... who would question Omni-Tek's right to both this planet and the resources therein, but each and every time they have been soundly defeated both by knowledge of the law and superior firepower. Omni-Tek does, indeed, protect.

Now, hundreds of years after colonizing Rubi-Ka, Omni-Tek stands strong and supreme atop the planet - Sales and exports of notum continue to rise daily and, despite some minor opposition, profits have held steady for a record number of consecutive years. But! This doesn't mean we can afford to be lazy and rest on our arrears - Not in the slightest. The Grand Company may thrive, but only with the dedication of loyal, trustworthy citizens such as you and myself. In fact, if you would like to help prove your loyalty to the corporation, there might be something I could use a hand with...

chore.Text: That is correct, but we won't take just anyone. You need to have the strength to execute your corporate duties, no matter how big or small. If you are interested, I may have a chore for you.

henri.Text: It's quite simple, really. The biggest bonehead around here, Henri, has crossed the line for the last time. He needs to be taken care of, and by that I mean prison time.

Text: {delay 1}Good to hear. Tell one of my privates to help you before you arrest Henri. No private will ask questions if you show him the OTAF Official Notice I gave you. However, they are not very patient..
That is all. You are dismissed.
Do not lose this one. Show it to a private, and do not keep him waiting.{close}

waiting.Text: That is all. You are dismissed.

Text: {delay 1}That is good to hear. You should send in your Omni-Tek application form, no need to sit on the fence.
As payment, here is a token of my gratitude, but it won't do you any good unless you make it official.

full.Text: Your hands are full. Make space and speak to me again.{close}

done.Text: That is all. You are dismissed.
